Yoruba: Ìgbòòrò onírúurú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì nínú kòkòrò Plasmodium vivax láti Sudan àti ìbáṣepọ̀ ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó ní pẹ̀lú àwọn ayakúrò yòókù.

English: Plasmodium vivax malaria is a neglected tropical disease in Africa due to low occurrence rates and lack of accurate diagnosis.
Luganda: Omusujja Plasmodium vivax ndwadde ey’omu bitundu eby’ebbugumu ogutafiibwako nnyo mu Afirika olw’okuba nti si mungi n’olw’obutakeberwa kutegeerekeka bulungi.
Yoruba: Àìsàn iba Plasmodium vivax jẹ ààrùn abóòrùn rìn tí a kò kọbi ara sí ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà látàrí àìwọ́pọ̀ rẹ̀ àti àìsí àyẹ̀wò tó pé pérépéré.
Zulu: Umalaleveva we-plasmodium vivax uyisifo zasezindaweni ezifudumele esinganakiwe ngenxa yamazinga okwenzeka aphansi nokwentuleka kokuhlonzwa okunembayo.
Hausa: Zazzaɓin cizon sauro na Plasmodium vivax cuta ce da aka yi watsi da ita a Afirka saboda ƙarancin faruwarta da kuma rashin ingantacciyar hanyar ganowa.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja malaria ao Plasmodium vivax ke bolwetši bjo bo hlagago ditikologong tše di fišago bjo bo tshedišwago mahlo ka Afrika ka baka la dikelo tša fase tša go hlaga ga bolwetši le tlhokego ya kalafo ye e nepagetšego.
Amharic: ፕላዝሞዲየም ቫይቫክስ ወባ በክስተቱ የማነስ ደረጃ እና በትክክለኛ ምርመራ እጦት የተነሳ በአፍሪካ ችላ የተባለ ትሮፒካል በሽታ ነው፡፡

English: Recently, there has been a dramatic increase in P. vivax cases in East Africa and reportedly spreading to western countries.
Luganda: Emabegako awo, wabaddewo okweyongera kwa P. vivax mu Afirika Buvanjuba (East Afirika) era nga gugambibwa okuba nti gusaasaanira mu mawanga ag’ebugwanjuba.
Yoruba: Láìpẹ́ yìí, àlékún tó ga ti wà lórí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ P.vivax ní apá Ìlà-Oòrùn Áfíríkà, ìròyìn sì gbé e pé ó ti ń tàn wọ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ìlú Ọba.
Zulu: Esikhathinin esisanda kudlula, sekube nokukhuphuka okusabisayo ezahlakalweni ze-P. vivax eMpumalanga Afrika kanti kubukwa ukuthi isabalalela nasemazweni asentshonalanga.
Hausa: A baya-bayan nan, an sami ƙaruwa mai girma a cikin P. vivax a Gabashin Afirka kuma an ba da rahoton yaɗuwa zuwa ƙasashen yamma.
Northern Sotho: Kgauswinyana, go bile le tlhatlogo ya godimo ya malwetši a P. vivax ka Bohlabela bja Afrika ao go kwagalago gore a phatlalalela ka dinageng tša bodikela.
Amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ በምስራቅ አፍሪካ የፕ.ቫይቫክስ አስደናቂ መጨመር እና ወደ ምእራባዊ ሃገሮች መዛመቱም ተዘግቧል፡፡

English: This study investigated the geographical origin and genetic diversity of P. vivax in Sudan by 14 microsatellite markers.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwanoonyereza ku kifo ekisibukamu wamu n’enjawulo eri mu P. vivax mu Sudan nga bakozesa ebirambi microsatellite 14.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí wo ibùdó orírun àti onírúurú ẹ̀jẹ̀ P.vivax ní Sudan pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ microsatellite 14.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luphenye indawomsuka kanye nengxubezimpawufuzo ye-P. vivax eSudani ngama-microsatelite marker ayi-14.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya binciki asalin yanki da kuma bambancin ƙwayoyin gado na P.vivax a Sudan ta alamomin microsatellite 14.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirile diphatišišo tša tikologo yeo bolwetši bo hlagilego gona le dipharologantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tša P. vivax go la Sudan ka maswao a 14 a maekhrosathalaete.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በሱዳን የሚገኘውን ፕ.ቫይቫክስ ጂኦግራፊያዊ አመጣጥ እና ጄኔቲካዊ ልዩነት በ14 የማይክሮ ሳተላይት ጠቋሚዎች መርምሯል፡፡

English: A total of 113 clinical P. vivax samples were collected from two districts, New Halfa and Khartoum in Sudan.
Luganda: Sampolo za P. vivax 113 zaakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu Disitulikiti bbiri, New Halfa ne Khartoum mu Sudan.
Yoruba: Àpapọ̀ àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ P.vivax 113 jẹ́ gbígbà ní àwọn agbègbè méjì, New Halfa àti Khartoum ní Sudan.
Zulu: Isibalo esiwu-113 samasampula e-P. vivax saqoqwa ezifundeni ezimbili, i-New Halfa kanye ne-Khartoum eSudani.
Hausa: An tattara jimlar samfuran P.vivax na asibiti 113 daga gundumomi guda biyu, wato New Halfa da kuma Khartoum a ƙasar Sudan.
Northern Sotho: Go kgobokeditšwe palomoka ya disampole tše 113 tša P. vivax go tšwa dilete tše pedi, e lego New Halfa le Khartoum go la Sudan.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ 113 ክሊኒካዊ የፕ.ቫይቫክስ ናሙናዎች ከሁለት ወረዳዎች፣ ማለትም ከኒው ሃልፋ እና ከሱዳን ካርቱም ተሰብስበዋል፡፡

English: In addition, data from 841 geographical samples retrieved from the database for global genetic analysis were included in the analysis to further the genetic relationships among the P. vivax isolates at regional and worldwide scales.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, obubaka okuva mu sampolo z’omu bitundu eby’enjawulo 841 ezaggyibwa mu kkuŋŋaanyizo ly’obubaka olw’okwekebejja ttwalirawamu zaateekebwa mu kwekebejja okwongera ku kwekaliriza nkolagana y’endagabutonde mu P. vivax isolates ku kigero ky’ekitundu n’ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, dátà láti àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ ibùdó 841 tí a gbà lórí àtẹ-ìpadátàmọ́ fún àtúpalẹ̀ jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì àgbááyé jẹ́ fífikún àtúpalẹ̀ náà láti tẹ̀síwájú àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ ajẹmọ́-jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì láàárín ayakúrò P.vivax ní ẹ̀kùnjẹkùn àti ní ipele ti àgbááyé.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, imininingo yamasampula ezindawo awu-841 atholakele esuka kwi-database yokuhlaziya yomhlaba yezimpawufuzo nawo abebaliwe esihlaziyweni ukuqhuba ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-isolate e-P. vivax nezikalo zomhlaba.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, bayanan da aka samo daga samfuran yanki na 841 da aka samo daga rumbun bayanai domin nazarin ƙwayoyin gado na duniya an haɗa su a cikin binciken domin ci gaba da dangantaka da ƙwayoyin gado a tsakanin P. vivax da aka keɓe a ma’auni na yanki da na duniya.
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, datha go tšwa disampoleng tša tikologo tše 841 ye e kgobokeditšwego go dathapeisi ya tshekatsheko ya ditlhamegotšini tša lefase ka bophara e akareditšwe go tshekatsheko go tšwetša pele dikamano tša ditlhamegotšini magareng ga dihlaolwa tša P. vivax go dikelo tša dilete le tša lefase ka bophara.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በፕ.ቫይቫክስ ልይቶች መካከል ያለውን ጄኔቲካዊ ግንኙነት በክልላዊ እና በአለም አቀፋዊ ሚዛን የበለጠ ለማሳደግ ከአለም አቀፍ ጄኔቲካዊ ትንተና መረጃ ቋት የተገኙት 841 ጂኦግራፊያዊ ናሙናዎች በትንተናው ውስጥ ተካተዋል፡፡

English: On a regional scale, we observed 91 unique and 8 shared haplotypes amongst the Sudan samples.
Luganda: Ku kigero ky’ekitundu, twekaliriza sampolo 91 ez’enjawulo ne haplotypes 8 ezigabanibwa mu sampolo z’omu Sudan.
Yoruba: Ní ipele ti ẹkùnjẹkùn, a ṣàkíyèsí hapílótáìpù 91 tó yàtọ̀ àti 8 tí ó jẹ́ pínpín láàrin àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ ti Sudan.
Zulu: Ngokwesikalo sesifunda, sibone ama-haplotype ahlukile angama-91 kanye nayi-8 emasampuleni aseSudani.
Hausa: A kan sikelin yanki, mun lura da haɗe-haɗe na musamman guda 91 da kuma gadaddun ƙwayoyin gado guda 8 na iyaye ɗaya da aka raba a tsakanin samfuran Sudan.
Northern Sotho: Go kelo ya ka seleteng, re lemogile dihapolothaepe tše 91 tša moswananoši le tše 8 tše di abelanwago magareng ga disampole tša Sudan.
Amharic: ከሱዳን ናሙናዎች መካከል በክልል ሚዛን 91 ልዩ እና 8 የጋራ ተቀራራቢ የቅንጅብራሂ ስብስቦችን ተመልክተናል፡፡

English: Such a high genetic diversity compared to other geographical isolates lends support to hypothesis that P. vivax was originated from Africa.
Luganda: Enjawulo eyo eyamaanyi mu ndagabutonde egeraageranyizibwa ku geographical isolates esobozesa ekiteeberezo nti P. vivax yava mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Irúfẹ́ ìgbésókè onírúurú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì yìí pẹ̀lú àfiwéra pẹ̀lú àwọn ayakúrò yòókù ṣèèrí sí àṣedánwò wí pé ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ni P.vivax ti ṣẹ̀ wá.
Zulu: Ingxubezimpawufzo ephuzulu kangaka ukuqhathaniswa nezinye izindawo yeseka umbono wokuthi i-P. vivax yasunguleka e-Afrika.
Hausa: Irin wannan babban bambancin ƙwayoyin gado idan aka kwatanta da sauran keɓantattun yanki yana ba da tallafi ga hasashen cewa P. vivax ya samo asali ne daga Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Pharologantšho yeo ya ditlhamegotšini ya godimo ge e bapetšwa le dihlaolwa tše dingwe tša tikologo di fana ka thekgo go haephothesese ya gore P. vivax e hlagile la mathomo go tšwa Afrika.
Amharic: ከሌሎች ጂኦግራፊያዊ ልይቶች ጋር ሲነጻጸር እንዲህ ያለው ከፍተኛ ጄኔቲካዊ ልዩነት ፕ.ቫይቫክስ የመነጨው ከአፍሪካ ነው የሚለውን መላምት ይደግፋል፡፡

English: On a global scale, as already demonstrated, we observed distinct genetic clustering of P. vivax isolates from Africa, South America, and Asia (including Papua New Guinea and Solomon Island) with limited admixture in all three clusters.
Luganda: Ku kigero ky’ensi yonna, nga bwe twakiraze edda, twekaliriza emminjawaza y’endagabutonde eya P. vivax isolates okuva mu Afirika, South America, ne Asia (omwonga mwe muli Papua New Guinea ne Solomon Island) omwo nga mwe muli obutabule bw’ebika ebisatu.
Yoruba: Ní ipele ti àgbááyé, gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti ṣe ṣàfihàn rẹ̀, a ṣàkíyèsí a rí ìṣùpọ̀ jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì tó yàtọ̀ àwọn P.vivax ayakúrò láti Áfíríkà, South America, àti Asia (tí ó fi mọ́ Papua New Guinea àti Solomon Island) pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀nba ìdàpọ̀ nínú àwọn ìṣùpọ̀ mẹ́tẹ̀ẹ̀ta yìí.
Zulu: Ngokomhlaba, njengoba sekuveziwe, sibone ukuqoqana okuhlukile kwezimpawufuzo kwe-P. vivax e-Afrika, South America, Asia (kubalwa ne-Papua New Guinea kanye ne-Solomon Island) ne-admixture ekalekile kulokhu kuqoqeka okuthathu.
Hausa: A kan sikelin duniya, kamar yadda aka riga aka nuna, mun lura da tarin nau’o’in ƙwayoyin gado na P. vivax keɓance daga Afirka da Kudancin Amurka da Asiya (ciki har da Papua New Guinea da kuma Solomon Island) tare da iyakantaccen abu a cikin dukkanin gungu uku.
Northern Sotho: Go sekala sa lefase ka bophara, ka ge go šetše go laeditšwe, re lemogile go hlopšha ga ditlhamegotšini tša go ikgetha tša dihlaolwa tša P. vivax go tšwa Afrika, Amerika Borwa, le Asia (go akaretša Papua New Guinea le Solomon Island) ka motswako wo o beetšwego mellwane ka dihlopheng tše tharo ka moka.
Amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ሚዛን ቀደም ሲል እንደታየው ከአፍሪካ፣ ደቡብ አሜሪካ እና እስያ (ፓፑዋ ኒው ጊኒ እና የሰሎሞን ደሴቶችን ጨምሮ) በሶስቱም ክምችቶች ውስጥ ከተወሰነ ቅልቅል ጋር የተለየ የፕ.ቫይቫክስ ጄኔቲካዊ ስብስብን አስተውለናል፡፡

English: The principal component analysis and phylogenetic tree showed similar clustering patterns and highlighted the contribution of the African isolates to the genetic variation observed globally.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza okwassibwako essira n’omuti ogwoleka ebika eby’enjawulo (phylogenetic tree) gwalaga emminjawaza ey’engeri emu era ne gulaga African isolates bye zikola ku njawulo eri mu ndagabutonde eyeekaliriziddwa mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̣̀ ẹ̀yà to jẹ́́ orí àti àtẹ ìtàn ìbáṣepọ̀ jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì fi irúfẹ́ bátánì ìṣùpọ̀ yìí hàn ó sì tún ṣàgbéjéde ipa àwọn ayakúrò ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà sí ìyàtọ̀ inú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì tí a ṣàkíyèsí káàkiri àgbááyé.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kwengxenyengqangi ne-phylogene kukhombise amaphethini okuqoqana afanayo futhi kwagqamisa umthelela wama-solate ase-Afrika ukuhlukeni kwezimpawufuzo okubonakalayo emhlabeni.
Hausa: Babbar ƙalailaicewar da aka gudanar da kuma bishiyar phylogenetic sun nuna nau’o’i tari iri ɗaya kuma ya ba da gudummawar keɓewar Afirka ga bambancin ƙwayoyin gado da aka gani a faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya karolo ya motheo le lešika la faelotšenethiki di laeditše diphathene tša tlhopho tše di swanago le go laetša seabe sa dihlaolwa tša Afrika go dipharologantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tše di lemogilwego lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: የዋና አካል ትንተና እና ስርወዘራዊ ዛፍ ተመሳሳይ የክምችት ቅጦችን አሳይተዋል፤ እንዲሁም አፍሪካዊያኑ ልይቶች በአለም ዙሪያ ለታየው ጄኔቲካዊ ልውጠት ያላቸውን ድርሻ አጉልተዋል፡፡

English: The East African P. vivax showed similarity with some of the Asian isolates suggesting potential recent introductions.
Luganda: P. vivax ey’omu Afirika yalaga enfaanana eri wakati wa Asian isolates ezimu era nga kino kyalaga ebiggya ebyakabaawo.
Yoruba: P.vivax ti apá Ìlà-Oòrùn Áfíríkà fi ìjọra hàn pẹ̀lú àwọn ayakúrò Asian léyìí tó ń dábàá ìfarahàn ohun kan tó ṣe pàtàkì.
Zulu: I-P. vivax yase Mpumalanga Afrika ibonakaliswa ngokufana namanye ama-isolate ase-Asia okugigiyela ukwethula okungase kube kusha.
Hausa: P. vivax na Gabashin Afirka ya nuna kamanceceniya da wasu keɓantattu na Asiya waɗanda suke nuna gabatarwar kwanan nan.
Northern Sotho: P. vivax ya Bohlabela bja Afrika e bontšhitše go swana le tše dingwe tša dihlaolwa tša Asia tše di šišinyago matseno ao a ka kgonagalago a bjale.
Amharic: በቅርቡ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ትውውቆችን እየጠቆመ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ፕ.ቫይቫክስ ከጥቂት እስያውያን ልይቶች ጋር ተመሳሳይነትን አሳይቷል፡፡

English: Our results show extensive genetic diversity co-occurring with significant multi-locus linkage disequilibrium, demonstrating the effectiveness of using microsatellite markers to implement effective control measures.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu biraga enjawulo yamaanyi mu ndagabutonde ejjira okumu ne multi-locus linkage disequilibrium, nga kiraga obulungi bw’okukozesa ebirambi bya microsatellite okukola ku ngeri ennungi eziyamba mu kutangira.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì wa ṣe àfihàn Ìgbòòrò ìyàtọ̀ onírúurú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìyara aláìmọye ọ̀nà, léyìí tí ó ṣe àfihàn ìpa lílo ohun-èlò makirosátẹláìtì gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà ìdèènà tó dójú àmì.
Zulu: Imiphumela yethu ikhombisa ingxubezimpawufuzo ezijulile zenzeka ngesikahti esisodwa kube nowenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene okugqamile, kuveza ukuphumelela kokusenzisa ama-microsatelilte marker ukusebenza izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo.
Hausa: Sakamako namu yana nuna ɗimbin bambance-bambancen ƙwayoyin gado da suke faruwa tare da haɗin wurare da yawa, yana nuna tasirin amfani da alamomin microsatellite don aiwatar da ingantattun matakan sarrafawa.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša rena di bontšha pharologantšho ya ditlhamegotšini tše di tseneletšego tše di hlagago mmogo le go se lekalekane ga kamantšho ya mafelo a mantši a bohlokwa, ao a bontšhago go šoma ka tshwanelo ga go šomiša maswao a maekhrosathalaete go phethagatša magato a mabotse a taolo.
Amharic: ውጤቶቻችን ፍሬያማ የቁጥጥር እርምጃዎችን ለመተግበር የማይክሮ ሳተላይት ጠቋሚዎችን ፍቱንነት እየጠቆሙ የሰፊ ጄኔቲካዊ ልዩነቶች ከጉልህ የብዘሃ-ነጥብ ትስስር አለመመጣጠን ጋር ህብረ-ክስተት መኖሩን ያሳያሉ፡፡

English: Researchers mapped the genetics of one of the parasites that cause malaria to track how different variants may be spreading across the globe.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baalamba ku maapu endagabutonde z’ekimu ku biyonkerezi ebireeta omusujja gw’ensiri okusobola okulondoola engeri ebika byabyo eby’enjawulo gye bisaasaanamu mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí ya àwòran jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì ọ̀kan nínú àwọn kòkò párásáìtì tó ń fa àìsàn ibà láti tọ pinpin bí oríṣiríṣi rẹ̀ ṣe lè di títàn káàkiri àgbááyé.
Zulu: Abawaningi bathola izimpawufuzo zesinye sezidligazi esidala umalaleveva ukulandela ukuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zingabe zisabalala kanjani emhlabeni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tsara taswirar ƙwayoyin gado na ɗaya daga cikin kaskokin da suke haifar da zazzaɓin cizon sauro domin bin diddigin yadda mabmabanta nau’o’in za su iya yaɗuwa a faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lotile mohlala wa ditšenethiki tša e tee ya dinwamadi tše di hlolago malaria go lota mohlala wa ka moo mehuta ye e fapafapanego e ka phatlalalago go kgabaganya lefase.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የተለያዩ ልውጠቶች እንዴት በአለም ላይ ሊሰራጩ እንደቻሉ ለመከታተል የወባ በሽታን ከሚያስከትሉ ጥገኛ ተውሳኮች የአንዱን የስነ ባህሪይ አወቃቀር በዝርዝር አስፍረዋል፡፡

English: They say the parasite, Plasmodium vivax, likely originated in Africa.
Luganda: Bagamba nti ekiyonkerezi, Plasmodium vivax, kirabika okuva nga kyava mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ó dà bí ẹni pé ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ni orírun kòkòko párásáìtì, Plasmodium vivax náà.
Zulu: Bathi isidlagazi, i-Plasmodium vivax, kungenzeka yaqala e-Afrika.
Hausa: Sun ce kaskar, Plasmodium vivax, mai yiwuwa ta samo asali ne daga Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gore senwamadi, Plasmodium vivax, se ka ba se hlagile ka Afrika.
Amharic: የፕላዝሞዲየም ቫይቫክስ ጥገኛ ተውሳክ ከአፍሪካ የመጣ ሳይሆን አይቀርም ይላሉ፡፡

English: Researchers previously thought that rates of malaria caused by this parasite were low.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasooka kulowooza nti ekigero ky’omusujja ekireetebwa ekiyonkerezi kino kitono.
Yoruba: Tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ àwọn Aṣèwádìí kókó rò pé ìwọ̀n ibà tí kòkòrò párásáìtì yìí ń fà kéré níye.
Zulu: Abacwaningi ngokudlule bebecabanga ukuthi amazinga kamalaleveva abangwa yilesi sidligazi aphansi.
Hausa: Masu bincike a baya sun yi tunanin cewa yawan zazzaɓin cizon sauro da wannan kaskar take haifarwa ba shi da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši peleng ba be ba nagana gore dikelo tša malaria tšeo di hlotšwego ke senwamadi se di be di le fase.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ቀደም ሲል በዚህ ጥገኛ ተውሳክ ምክንያት የሚከሰተው የወባ በሽታ መጠን አነስተኛ ነው ብለው ያስቡ ነበር፡፡

English: But, it seems that cases are dramatically increasing in East Africa and other parts of the world.
Luganda: Wabula, omusujja ogwo gweyongerera ddala mu Afirika Buvanjuba n’ebitundu by’ensi ebirala.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, ó ti ń jọ bí ẹni pé àlékún ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ rẹ̀ tí ń ga sí i ní Ìlà-Oòrùn Áfíríkà àti àwọn apá ibòmìíràn lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Kodwa kubukeka ngathi izikhawu ziyakhula kakhlu eMpumalanga Afrika nakwezinzye izingxenye zomhlaba.
Hausa: Amma, da alama matsalolin suna ƙaruwa sosai a Gabashin Afirka da sauran sassan duniya.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, go bontšha gore malwetši a tloga a hlatloga ka tsela ye e makatšago go la Bohlabela bja Afrika le dikarolong tše dingwe tša lefase.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በምስራቅ አፍሪካ እና በሌሎቹም የአለም ክፍሎች በሽታዎቹ በአስደናቂ ሁኔታ እየጨመሩ የመጡ ይመስላል፡፡

English: Plasmodium vivax (PV) malaria cases are usually not severe, but recent studies show that PV can lie dormant in people and repeatedly reinfect them, causing them to miss work.
Luganda: Omusujja gw’ensiri ogwa Plasmodium vivax (PV) tegutera kuba gwamaanyi, naye okunoonyereza okw’emabegako awo kulaga nti PV gusobola okwekweka mu bantu ne gubakosa olutatadde, ne gubalemesa n’okukola emirimu.
Yoruba: Àìsàn ibà Plasmodium vivax (PV) kìí sábà mú ìnira dání, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìwádìí àìpẹ́ yìí ti fi hàn pé PV lè wararo lára ènìyàn tí yóò sì máa báwọn fíra lemọ́lemọ́, léyìí tí yóò jẹ́ kí wọn ó má sá lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ òòjọ́ wọn.
Zulu: Izikhawu ze-Plasmodium vivax (PV) zivame ukungabi zimbi kakhulu, kodwa kulokhu izingcwaningo ziveza ukuthi i-PV ingahlala ingaveli kubantu, ibathelele ngokuphindaphinda, ibenze ukuthi baphuthe emsebenzini.
Hausa: Yawanci zazzaɓin cizon sauro na Plasmodium vivax (PV) ba ya da tsanani, amma bincike na baya-bayan nan ya nuna cewa PV yana iya kwantawa a cikin mutane kuma ya sake kama su akai-akai, ya haifar musu da rasa zuwa aiki.
Northern Sotho: Malwetši a malaria a Plasmodium vivax (PV) gantši ga a šoro kudu, eupša dinyakišišo tša bjale di bontšha gore PV e ka iphihla mebeleng ya batho le go ba fetela leboelela, ya hlola gore ba lofe mošomong.
Amharic: የፕላዝሞዲየም ቫይቫክስ (ፕ.ቫ) ወባ ህመሞች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ከባድ አይደሉም፣ ነገር ግን በቅርብ ጊዜ የተደረጉ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ፕ.ቫ በሰዎች ላይ አድብቶ በመደበቅ በተደጋጋሚ እየበከለ ከስራቸው ሊያስቀራቸው ይችላል፡፡

English: This, along with the need for repeated treatment, can slow economies.
Luganda: Kino bw’okigatta ku bwetaavu bw’okujjanjabwa buli kiseera kiziŋŋamya ebyenfuna.
Yoruba: Èyí, pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ àti máa gba ìtọ́jú lemọ́lemọ́, lè máa fa ọrọ̀-ajé nílẹ̀.
Zulu: Lokhu, kanye nesidingo sokwelashwa kuphindelelwa, kungalimaza iminotho.
Hausa: Wannan, tare da buƙatar maimaita magani, yana iya rage tattalin arziki.
Northern Sotho: Se, gammogo le nyakego ya go hwetša kalafo ya leboelela, di ka ditela kgolo ya diekonomi.
Amharic: ይህ ከተደጋጋሚ ህክምና አስፈላጊነት ጋር ኢኮኖሚን ሊጎትት ይችላል፡፡

English: In this study, researchers wanted to analyse the genetics of PV parasites detected at various places globally.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okwekaliriza ebiyonkerezi bya PV ebyakengebwa mu bifo ebyenjawulo mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì kòkòrò párásáìtì PV tí a ṣàlábàápàdé ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ibi káàkiri àgbááyé.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuhlaziya izimpawufuzo zezidlagazi ze-PV ezitholwa ezindaweni ezahlukene emhalabeni wonke.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so yin nazarin ƙwayoyin gado na kaskokin PV da aka gano a wurare daban-daban a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go sekaseka ditlhamegotšini tša dinwamadi tša PV tše di lemogilwego mafelong a go fapafapana lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች የተገኙትን የፕ.ቫ  ጥገኛ ተውሳኮች ስነ ባህሪይ ለመተንተን ፈልገዋል፡፡

English: This genetic and geographical data can help health authorities to limit the spread of PV and better treat malaria.
Luganda: Obubaka buno obw’endagabutonde wamu n’obwebitundu eby’enjawulo busobola okuyamba aboobuyinza ku byobulamu okuziyiza ensaasaana ya PV n’okujjanjaba obulungi omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn dátà jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì àti ti ibùdó lè ra àwọn aláṣẹ ètò-ìlera láti mú àdínkù bá ìtànkálẹ PV àti ìtọ́jú tó dára sí I fún àìsàn ibà.
Zulu: Le mininingo yezimpawufuzo nendawo ingasiza abaphathi bezempilo ukunqanda ukusabalala kwe-PV kanye nokwelapha kangcono umalaleveva.
Hausa: Wannan bayanan ƙwayoyin gado da na yanki na iya taimakawa hukumomin kiwon lafiya wajen taƙaita yaɗuwar PV da kuma mafi kyawun maganin zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Datha ye ya ditlhamegotšini le ya tikologo e ka thuša balaodi ba maphelo go fokotša go phatlalala ga PV le go alafa malaria bokaone.
Amharic: ይህ ጄኔቲካዊ እና ጂኦግራፊያዊ መረጃ የፕ.ቫ ስርጭትን ለመገደብ እና ወባን በተሻለ ሁኔታ ለማከም የጤና ባለስልጣናትን ሊረዳቸው ይችላል፡፡

English: The researchers extracted DNA from finger-prick blood samples collected from patients with PV malaria in New Halfa and Khartoum, both in Sudan.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baggya DNA nga bakozesa sampolo z’omusaayi gw’oku ngalo z’abalwadde abalina omusujja gwa PV mu New Halfa ne Khartoum, ebisangibwa mu Sudan.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gba DNA láti ara àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ atìka-ọwọ́-gbà tí a gbà lára aláìsàn kan kí ó ní àìsan ibà PV ní New Halfa àti Khartoum, méjèèjì ní orílẹ̀-èdè Sudan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakhiphe i-DNA kumasampula egazi athathwa ngomunwe ezigulini ezinomalaleveva we-PV eNew Halfa naseKhartoum, eSudani.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun fitar da ƙwayar halittar DNA daga samfuran jinin da aka ɗauka daga yatsa da aka tattara daga marasa lafiya da ke ɗauke da zazzaɓin cizon sauro na PV a New Halfa da kuma Khartoum, duka a ƙasar Sudan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšere DNA go tšwa go disampole tše di tšerwego ka go hlaba monwana ka tšhwaana go balwetši ba malaria a PV go tšwa New Halfa le Khartoum, tše di lego Sudan ka bobedi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኒው ሃልፋ እና በሱዳን ካርቱም ከሚገኙት የፕ.ቫ ወባ በሽተኞች ጣት ላይ ከተወሰዱ የደም ናሙናዎች ዲኤንኤ አውጥተዋል፡፡

English: They also used data from samples collected in other parts of Africa, South America, and Asia.
Luganda: Era baakozesa n’obubaka bwe baakuŋŋaanya okuva mu bitundu bya Afirika ebirala, South Amerika ne Asia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún lo àwọn dátà láti ara àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí a gbà ní àwọn ibòmìíràn ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà, South America, àti Asia.
Zulu: Baphinde basebenzisa imininingo esuselwa easampuleni aqoqwe kwezinye izingxenye ze-Afrika, South America ne-Asia.
Hausa: Sun kuma yi amfani da bayanai daga samfuran da aka tattara a wasu sassan Afirka da Amurka ta Kudu da kuma Asiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše le datha go tšwa go disampole tše di kgobokeditšwego ka dikarolong tše dingwe tša Afrika, Amerika Borwa, le Asia.
Amharic: በሌሎች የአፍሪካ፣ ደቡብ አሜሪካ እና እስያ ክፍሎች ከተሰበሰቡ ናሙናዎች የተገኙ መረጃዎችንም ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: They compared the samples to find similarities and differences across the locations.
Luganda: Baageraageranya sampolo okuzuula ebifaanagana n’ebyawukana mu bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àfiwéra àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ náà láti wá ìjọra àti ìyàtọ̀ káàkiri àwọn ibùdó.
Zulu: Baqhathanise amasampula ukuthiola ukufana nokuhluka kwehlukana kwezindawo.
Hausa: Sun kwatanta samfuran don gano kamanceceniya da bambance-bambance a cikin wuraren.
Northern Sotho: Ba bapeditše disampole go hwetša dilo tše swanago le tše di sa swanego go kgabaganya ditikologo.
Amharic: በቦታዎች ላይ ተመሳሳይነቶችን እና ልዩነቶችን ለማግኘት ናሙናዎቹን አነጻጽረዋል፡፡

English: The researchers found that the genetics of PV samples were generally more similar to other samples from the same continent.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti endagabutonde eza sampolo za PV okutwaliza awamu zaali zifaanagana ne sampolo endala okuva ku ssemazinga y’omu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìi rí I pe jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì àpẹẹ.rẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ PV káàkiri ní ìjọra pẹ̀lú àwọn jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì mìíràn ní ilẹ̀ kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi izimpawufuzo zamasampula e-PV bezifana namanye amasampula asezwenikazi elilodwa.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙwayoyin gadon samfuran PV sun fi kama da sauran samfurori daga nahiya iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore ditlhamegotšini tša disampole tša PV ka kakaretšo di be di swana le disampole tše dingwe go tšwa kontinenteng ye e swanago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የፕ.ቫ  ናሙናዎች ስነ ባህሪይ በጥቅሉ ከአንድ አህጉር ከሚገኙ ሌሎች ናሙናዎች ጋር የበለጠ ተመሳሳይ መሆናቸውን ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: This means they could potentially tell where a sample came from based on its genetics.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti baali basobola okumanya sampolo w’eva okusinziira ku ndagabutonde ya sampolo.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé ó ṣeéṣe kí wọn ó lè sọ ibi tí àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ kan ti wá pẹ̀lú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì rẹ̀.
Zulu: Lokhu kusho ukuthi bengakwazi ukusho ukuhti isampula liqhamukephi ngokubuka izimpawufuzo zalo.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin za su iya bayyana inda samfurin ya fito bisa ga ƙwayoyin gadonsa.
Northern Sotho: Se se šupa gore ba ka kgona go tseba moo sampole e tšwago gona go lebeletšwe ditlhamegotšini tša yona.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት በስነ-ባህሪይው ላይ በመመስረት ናሙናው ከየት እንደመጣ ሊያውቁ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: Interestingly, they saw that samples collected in Africa were more genetically diverse than samples from other continents.
Luganda: Ekyewuunyisa, baalaba nti sampolo eziggyibwa mu Afirika zaali zirimu enjawulo mu ndagabutonde okusinga ku sampolo ez’oku ssemazinga endala.
Yoruba: Ohun tó yani lẹ́nu ni pé, wọ́n rí i pé àwọn jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì tí a gbà ní Áfíríkà wà lónírúurú ju ̀wọn àpẹẹrẹ láti àwọn ilẹ̀ mìíràn lọ.
Zulu: Ngokuxakile, babone ukuthi amasampula aqoaqwe e-Afrika abehluke kakhulu ngokwezimpawufuzo kunamasampula akwamanye amazwekazi.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa shi ne, sun ga samfuran da aka tattara a Afirka sun bambanta ta hanyar ƙwayoyin gado fiye da samfuran sauran nahiyoyi.
Northern Sotho: Sa go kgahliša, ba lemogile gore disampole tše di kgobokeditšwego ka Afrika di be di farologana go lebeletšwe ditlhamegotšini go fapana le disampole tše di tšwago dikontinenteng tše dingwe.
Amharic: በሚገርም ሁኔታ በአፍሪካ ውስጥ የሚሰበሰቡ ናሙናዎች ከሌሎች አህጉራት ከሚመጡ ናሙናዎች ይልቅ ጄኔቲካዊ ልዩነት እንዳላቸው አስተውለዋል፡፡

English: In other words, samples collected in Asia, for example, were more similar to other Asian samples than African samples were to other African samples.
Luganda: Kwe kugamba, bw’otwala sampolo ezaakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu Asia ng’ekyokulabirako, zaali zifaanagana nnyo ne sampolo endala ez’omu Asia okusinga ku sampolo z’omu Afirika ez’omu bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Lọ́nà mííràn, àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí a gbà ní Asia, fún àpẹẹrẹ, ní ìjọra pẹ̀lú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ àwọn ènìyàn ilẹ̀ Asia ju àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà sí ti àwọn ènìyàn ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà lọ.
Zulu: Ngamanye amazwi, amasampula aqoqwe e-Asia, isibonelo, abefana kakhulu kwamanye amasampula ase-Asia kunawase-Afrika efana namanye ase-Afrika.
Hausa: A wani ɓangaren kuma, samfuran da aka tattara a Asiya, alal misali, sun fi kama da sauran samfuran Asiya fiye da samfuran Afirka da sauran samfuran Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ka mantšu a mangwe, disampole tše di kgobokeditšwego ka Asia, mohlala, di be di swana kudu le disampole tše dingwe tša Asia go fapana le disampole tša Afrika ge di bapetšwa le disampole tše dingwe tša Afrika.
Amharic: በሌላ አነጋገር፤ ለምሳሌ የአፍሪካ ናሙናዎች ከሌሎች የአፍሪካ ናሙናዎች ጋር ከሚመሳሰሉት በላይ በእስያ ውስጥ የተሰበሰቡ ናሙናዎች ከሌሎች የእስያ ናሙናዎች ጋር በይበልጥ ይመሳሰላሉ፡፡

English: The genetic diversity in Africa suggests that PV came from Africa.
Luganda: Enjawulo mu ndagabutonde ez’omu Afirika eraga nti PV yava mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Ìpónírúurú jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà yìí dábàá rẹ̀ pé ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ni PV ti wá.
Zulu: Ingxubezimpawufuzo e-Afrika ikhomba ukuthi i-PV isuka e-Afrika.
Hausa: Bambancin ƙwayoyin gado a Afirka yana nuna cewa PV ya fito ne daga Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dipharologantšho tša ditlhamegotšini ka Afrika di šišinya gore PV e tšwa ka Afrika.
Amharic: በአፍሪካ ያለው የጄኔቲካዊ ልዩነት ፕ.ቫ ከአፍሪካ እንደመጣ ይጠቁማል፡፡

English: They also saw that African samples were more similar to Asian samples than South American samples.
Luganda: Era baalaba nti sampolo z’omu Afirika zaali zifaanaganamu ne sampolo z’omu Asia okusinga ku ezo ez’omu South Amerika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún rí i pé àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà fara jo àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ ilẹ̀ Asia ju àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ ilẹ South America lọ.
Zulu: Babone ukuthi amasampula ase-Afrika afana kakhuli nawase-Asia kunase-South America.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma ga cewa samfuran Afirka sun fi kama da samfuran Asiya fiye da samfuran Kudancin Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba lemogile gore disampole tša Afrika di be di swana kudu le disampole tša Asia go feta disampole tša Borwa bja Amerika.
Amharic: ከደቡብ አሜሪካ ናሙናዎች ይልቅ የአፍሪካ ናሙናዎች ከእስያ ናሙናዎች ጋር ተመሳሳይ መሆናቸውንም ተመልክተዋል፡፡

English: This means people or animals infected with PV probably recently moved between Africa and Asia.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti abantu oba ebisolo ebikosebwa ne PV byandiba nga byasengukako okuva mu Afirika ne bidda mu Asia.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ènìyàn tàbí ẹranko tí ó kó PV ṣeéṣe kí ó yí láàrin Áfíríkà àti Asia láìpẹ́ yìí.
Zulu: Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu ezilwane abathelelwe yi-PV kungenzeka ukuthi bebesanda kuhamba phakathi kwe-Afrika ne-Asia.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin ke nan mutane ko dabbobin da suka kamu da PV tabbas sun ƙaura tsakanin Afirka da kuma Asiya kwanan nan.
Northern Sotho: Se se šupa gore batho goba diphoofolo bao ba fetetšwego ke PV ba ka ba ba sa tšwa go etela ka Afrika le Asia.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት በፕ.ቫ የተያዙ ሰዎች ወይም እንስሳት ምናልባትም በቅርቡ በአፍሪካ እና በኤስያ መካከል ተንቀሳቅሰዋል።

English: Mapping the genetics of a parasite in this way gives scientists insights into how the pathogen spreads to different locations.
Luganda: Okulamba endagabutonde z’ekiyonkerezi ku maapu mu ngeri eyo kiwa bannassaayansi ebirowoozo ku ngeri pathogen gye zisaasaana mu bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Yáya àwòrán jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì kòkòro párásáìtì ní ọ̀nà yìí fún àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ní òye bí kòkòrò yìí ṣe ń tàn kiri ̀wọn ibùdó oríṣiríṣi.
Zulu: Ukudweba izimpawufuzo zesidlagazi ngale ndlela kunikeza ososayensi ukubona ukuthi izifo zisabalala kanjani ezindawei ezahlukene.
Hausa: Samar da taswirar ƙwayoyin gado na kaska ta wannan hanya yana bai wa masana kimiyya damar fahimtar yadda ƙwayar cutar take yaɗuwa zuwa wurare daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Go lota mohlala wa ditlhamegotšini tša senwamadi ka tsela ye go fa ditsebi tša mahlale lesedi mabapi le ka moo pathogen e phatlalalago ka gona go ditikologo tše di fapafapanego.
Amharic: የጥገኛ ተውሳኮችን ስነ ባህሪይ በዚህ መልኩ በዝርዝር ማዘጋጀት ለሳይንቲስቶቹ በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋስያን ወደ ተለያዩ ቦታዎች እንዴት እንደሚዛመቱ ግንዛቤ ይሰጣችዋል፡፡

English: The researchers say future studies could use this information to identify geographical characteristics, like mountains, that separate different PV variants.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okunoonyereza okw’omu maaso kuyinza okukozesa obubaka buno okufuna obubonero obw’enjawulo nga ebitundu by’omu nsozi, ebyawulo enjawulo za PV ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìi sọ pé àwọn ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú lè ṣàmúlò àlàyé yìí láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ àbùdá ibùdó, bí àwọn òkè, tí ó da oríṣìí àwọn PV sọ́tọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi izingcwaningo zangomuso zingasebenzisa lolu lwazi ukuhlonza izimpawu zendawo njengezintaba ezehlukanisa izinhlobo ze-PV ezahlukene.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce binciken na gaba zai iya amfani da wannan bayanin domin gano halaye na yanki, kamar tsaunuka, waɗanda ke raba nau’o’in PV daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di ka šomiša tshedimošo ye go hlaola dipharologantšho tša tikologo, go swana le dithaba, tšeo di kgaoganyago mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya PV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች ይህን መረጃ እንደ ተራሮች ያሉ የፕ.ቫን ልውጠቶች የሚወስኑ ጂኦግራፊያዊ ባህሪያትን ለመለየት ሊጠቀሙ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: The researchers that performed this study were based in Sudan, Eritrea, France, and the USA.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abaakola okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu Sudan, Eritrea, France, ne USA.
Yoruba: Ilẹ̀ Sudan, Eritrea, France, àti USA ni àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí tí wọ́n ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí fìdímúlẹ̀ sí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abenze lolu cwaningo bebeseSudani, Eritrea, eFransi kanye naseUSA.
Hausa: Masu binciken da suka gudanar da wannan binciken sun kasance a Sudan da Eritriya da Faransa da kuma Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši bao ba dirilego dinyakišišo tše ba be ba etšwa Sudan, Eritrea, Fora, le USA.
Amharic: ይህን ጥናት ያካሄዱት ተመራማሪዎች መቀመጫቸው በሱዳን፣በኤርትራ፣ በፈረንሳይ እና በአሜሪካ ነበር፡፡
